content: Goreleaser .goreleaser.yaml: version:2, builds section with GOOS=[linux,darwin,windows] GOARCH=[amd64,arm64], ldflags with -s -w to strip debug info + version injection, archives with format_overrides zip for windows. GitHub Actions: trigger on tags (*), permissions: contents: write, uses goreleaser/goreleaser-action@v7, env GITHUB_TOKEN. Test locally: goreleaser release --snapshot --clean. Verify config: goreleaser check. File lives at repo root.
